description: Every name standards/060-auth.md and standards/070-rbac.md give an implementation to carry, spelled once. Three implementations that each chose their own spelling for one refusal were three answers to one question; this file answers it once. A wire value is exact in every language. An identifier follows the language's own casing rule from the canonical spelling: Go exports PascalCase, TypeScript uses lowerCamel for members and PascalCase for types, PHP uses PascalCase for classes and lowerCamel for methods. Where a language's own convention forces a different name, the entry says so under 'except' with the reason, and nothing else is an exception. An implementation carries a name that is in this file, or the name is not carried.

packages.description: One package per concept, the same name in each language; the framework binding is named for its framework under auth/.

except.php: Composer's autoload-dev convention names test support Testing

auth/binding.note: the framework-free core a binding sits on, where a language has one, is Platform\Auth\Http in PHP and nothing separate elsewhere

except.go: Callers alias the import. The path is log and the standard library already owns that name.

log.note: Go's binding is slog.Handler. The Express binding is log/express. PHP implements Psr\Log\LoggerInterface, and a CodeIgniter app points Services::logger at that implementation. There is no CodeIgniter\Log\LoggerInterface in 4.7.

wire.description: Values that cross a boundary: a log line, an audit event, a response body, a configuration file. Exact in every language.

token_error_codes.rule: 060 AU2. Every one is a 401. The code reaches the log and the audit event and never the response body.

headers.rule: 060 AU2. The access token is the credential and travels in RFC 6750's header; the ID token crosses beside it and is never a credential.

denial_reasons.rule: 070 RB8. A denied decision carries exactly one. undeclared_permission and invalid_scope are also errors, and the decision beside the error carries the reason.

tenancies.rule: 060 AU8. single_host is also the declaration of a product with no tenants.

no_grant_reasons.rule: 060 AU8, 092 TH3. Carried on the outcome none, each with one answer.

authentication_outcomes.rule: 060 AU6, AU8, AU9. The status is the one an application route answers; the three /me routes answer choose with 200.

refusal_reasons.rule: 060 AU6 gives two of its own; the other four are the no-grant reasons carried through unrenamed.

host_tenant_answers.rule: 092 TH1, TH3. What a host names, as the HostTenant port answers it.

problem_slugs.rule: 050 HA3 fixes the URI as https://errors.aurumalpha.dev/<service>/<slug>; 060 fixes these slugs.

routes.rule: 060 AU6, AU8; 050 HA5 puts the version in the path.

values.POST /api/v1/me/active: activate a grant; absent where the policy holds one grant per subject

log_error_types.rule: 030 SC2. The starter set the log package exports, the same wire string in every language. Not a closed set of every error.type a service may emit: a failure a second product would not raise stays in that product. An error another product would raise is added here, in all three languages, the first time any product needs it. Token refusals, denial reasons, and the Keycloak codes stay the names they already have.

options.description: The dimensions a product declares in its Conventions and passes to the identity tier. The field name is the canonical spelling under the language's casing; the values are exact.

policy.rule: switchInSession without multipleGrants is refused where the policy is declared

anonymousRole.type: a system role name, or absent

hostTenant.type: the HostTenant port; required under host_names_tenant, refused under single_host

scopes.type: the ScopeHierarchy; the flat hierarchy when absent

defaultGrant.type: a role and a scope; required under provider_is_source

verifier.type: the Verifier; absent only in a no-provider deployment

bindings.type: the BindingStore; required under multipleGrants, refused otherwise

audit.type: the AuditSink; the no-op when absent

except.php: clock, because PSR-20 names the interface ClockInterface

ports.description: The interfaces a product implements over its own tables and its own provider. Operation names are the canonical spelling under the language's casing.

types.description: The named things a product's code touches. Canonical spelling; a language applies its casing and nothing else.

operations.description: The operations 070 RB7 and 060 AU8 name, under the language's casing.
